name: @cast-operations/root
description: Cast Operations observability and incident-response platform.

scripts.config-to-test: node ./Scripts/Install/ReplaceValueInConfig.js ENVIRONMENT test && node ./Scripts/Install/ReplaceValueInConfig.js APP_TAG test
scripts.start: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose up --remove-orphans -d $npm_config_services && npm run status-check
scripts.save-logs: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose logs --tail=100000 $npm_config_services > logs.txt
scripts.write-logs: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose logs -f $npm_config_services > logs.txt
scripts.build: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build $npm_config_services
scripts.force-build: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && npm run prerun && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache $npm_config_services
scripts.force-build-dev: npm run config-to-dev && npm run force-build
scripts.prod: npm run config-to-prod && set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.dev: npm run config-to-dev && npm run prerun && set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --remove-orphans -d $npm_config_services
scripts.exec: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml exec -it
scripts.remove-all-containers: docker stop $(docker ps -a -q) && docker rm $(docker ps -a -q) || echo 'No running containers'
scripts.update: npm run prerun && set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose pull && npm run start
scripts.run-probes: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && docker compose up --remove-orphans -d probe-1 probe-2
scripts.deploy-test: kubectl config use-context cast-operations-test && helm upgrade cast-operations ./HelmChart/Public/cast-operations -f ./HelmChart/Public/cast-operations/values.yaml  -f ./HelmChart/Values/test.values.yaml
scripts.template-deploy-test: kubectl config use-context cast-operations-test && helm template  cast-operations ./HelmChart/Public/cast-operations -f ./HelmChart/Public/cast-operations/values.yaml  -f ./HelmChart/Values/test.values.yaml --debug
scripts.deploy-prod: kubectl config use-context cast-operations-prod && helm upgrade cast-operations ./HelmChart/Public/cast-operations -f ./HelmChart/Public/cast-operations/values.yaml  -f ./HelmChart/Values/prod.values.yaml
scripts.ai-eval: set -a && { [ ! -f ./config.env ] || . ./config.env; } && set +a && export DATABASE_HOST=localhost DATABASE_PORT=5400 RUN_DATABASE_MIGRATIONS_ON_BOOT=false && node --require ts-node/register ./Scripts/AI/RunInvestigationEval.ts

author: Cast Operations <hello@latticeruntime.com> (https://latticeruntime.com/)
